For the last 5 years, I've been traveling around the world on a mission to document 1,001 stories on #water and #ClimateChange. 

To date I have documented 850 stories in 20 countries on six continents. Antarctica is in the works. 

https://t.co/lzUN9FxI2o https://t.co/lRqCoKe0N2

We gave postcards out with images from the journey (h/t @annawoorim for the design)! 

Just over 100 people stopped by to listen to / share stories about #water and #climate change. https://t.co/cu6aSYQpzQ

.@sabouzz and I recorded 10 #water and #climatechange stories from passers-by (the tally to 1001 continues!). 

My favorite: a couple who met doing disaster relief for @fema. 

Listening is an act of love ❤️ https://t.co/3anldAEuL1

Happy almost #EarthDay! 

1,001 Stories, an interactive map of audio stories about #water and #climate change, launches tomorrow. 

I’m over the moon excited to share this map with you. It’s been five + years in the making. 

Watch this space 👀 https://t.co/bTSvsExVwB
